text:
Sam (CEO): Quick debrief from today's all-hands on the hub-&-spoke proposal and headcount impact. Leaving answers here for folks who asked during Q&A.
Ivy (People Ops): First q: does hub-&-spoke mean manager headcounts move to hubs or stay with spokes?
Sam (CEO): Operationally hubs will carry the manager headcounts for shared platform roles; spokes keep headcount for product-facing engineers. We'll publish a mapping doc.
Theo (Head Eng): How many roles shift into hubs vs new hires? Any hard numbers?
Ivy (People Ops): Short answer: ~12 roles will transfer into hubs from existing pools; 6 are net-new infra hires approved for Q2.
Rico (Recruiting): Timeline for those 6 hires? Can we start sourcers on reqs now?
Sam (CEO): Yes, prioritize sourcing this sprint. Use the "hub-infra" tag in Greenhouse and mark as high-priority.
Anya (Product): If a spoke loses an IC to a hub, is there guaranteed backfill or budget to replace?
Ivy (People Ops): There's a backfill pledge: spokes get priority to refill within the quarter. If headcount can't be replaced, teams get contractor runway while we reprioritize roadmap.
Marta (Manager): For performance cycles, will organization changes affect calibration or promotion timelines?
Sam (CEO): No disruption planned. Promotions and calibrations proceed on the same cadence; we'll include notes where an employee moves teams.
Theo (Head Eng): Who signs off on transfers? Is this a manager-to-manager approval or needs exec OK?
Ivy (People Ops): Manager + receiving hub lead signoff usually enough. Escalate to me if there's ambiguity or cross-budget issues.
ops-bot: Reminder: submit transfer requests with the OrgOps form: /forms/org-transfer by Friday EOD.
Rico (Recruiting): Also: referral policy stands for net-new hires; internal moves don't trigger referral payouts.
Sam (CEO): Thanks all. Well drop the hub-spoke mapping and a short FAQ in #all-hands-docs within 48 hours. Ping Ivy directly if you're blocked. :+1:
Marta (Manager): Helpful, thanks Sam and team.
Anya (Product): Appreciate the quick follow-up.
Ivy (People Ops): Office hours for managers Tues 3pm PT to walk through transfer forms. Invite soon.
